text:
lucy: Heads-up: I'm drafting a concise migration note for the v1->v2 API deprecation focused on snippet edits, model alias map, and redirect cadence. Putting a draft PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301
omar: Nice. Two quick asks: show minimal diffs for JS and Python, and an appendix with fallback behavior when clients hit v1 during the cutover.
tia: Also call out streaming payload framing changes. Some integrations parse by line breaks; we should show old vs new minimal examples.
ben: Ops concern: delay public publish until the docs-redirect canary finishes. If we flip early support will be spammed. Can we mark the page private/internal until rollout completes?
lucy: Plan: merge internal-only page first, coordinate canary, then swap the public page + update quickstarts. I'll add a rollout checklist in PR.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: docs-redirects v2->v1-routes canary on 2026-03-25T05:00:00Z
omar: I'll prepare two SDK PRs: js/ts snippets and python snippets. I'll include a tiny compat shim: `compatV1toV2(request)` + tests.
tia: I'll produce a model alias table for embeds and chat models; will include recommended quantized variants and note expected quality delta.
ben: Support doc: quick rollback steps if redirects misroute (how to re-point clients to v1 shim, who to call in SRE). I'll draft and link from the PR.
lucy: Action items in PR: [lucy] finalize FAQ + internal merge; [omar] JS/TS + Python snippet PRs; [tia] model alias map; [ben] rollback doc; [ops] run canary then full rollout.
omar: ETA ~3h for snippets and tests. Will post links here when ready.
lucy: Also adding a 2-line quickstart callout about streaming changes so users don't keep old parsing code. Small sync tomorrow 11am PT to confirm canary.
ben: I'll be on watch for the canary.
lucy: thanks all, updating PR with timeline and owners now.
